Implements OT-85: a public WhatsApp lead/help assistant for One Time with durable raw-byte webhook intake, encrypted WhatsApp inbox/outbox records, deterministic intent handling, consent/suppression, family/school lead capture, hash-only account-link verification, and a short-lived safe-status seam.

- Sender/recipient keys and provider refs are HMAC-derived.

- This is a read-only view over local communication intents, not a mailbox.
- `pending` maps to `intent_queued` / `Queued locally`.

- Adds owned route-registration hook for `GET /api/v1/communications`, `GET /api/v1/crm/contacts/:contactId/communications`, and `GET /app/communications`.
- Server derives account/product scope from `ReadOnlySessionScopePort`; browser scope fields are ignored.

- Postgres adapter uses `SELECT` only and does not select outbox `payload`.
- Communications reads do not call worker claim/retry/provider/BNA/contact mutation/auth audit paths.
